te: The Dutch East India Company is nationalized by the Batavian Republic.
dz: 荷兰东印度公司被巴达维亚共和国国有化。
de: The Dutch East India Company is nationalized by the Batavian Republic.

t: 《邦联条例》在美国生效。
te: The Articles of Confederation goes into effect in the United States.
dz: 《邦联条例》在美国生效。
de: The Articles of Confederation goes into effect in the United States.

t: Sarah Good, Sarah Osborne, 和Tituba 被带到马萨诸塞州Sale…
te: Sarah Good, Sarah Osborne, and Tituba are brought before local magistrates in Salem Village, Massachusetts, beginning w…
dz: Sarah Good, Sarah Osborne, 和Tituba 被带到马萨诸塞州Salem村的地方法官面前, 开始所谓的Salem女巫审判.
de: Sarah Good, Sarah Osborne, and Tituba are brought before local magistrates in Salem Village, Massachusetts, beginning what would become known as the Salem witch trials.

te: Samuel de Champlain reclaims his role as commander of New France on behalf of Cardinal Richelieu.
dz: 塞缪尔·德·钱普兰(Samuel de Champlain)代表红衣主教里切利乌(Richelieu)重新夺回了自己作为新法国指挥官的角色.
de: Samuel de Champlain reclaims his role as commander of New France on behalf of Cardinal Richelieu.

t: 英国查理一世于2月所发的文字授权英格兰的每个郡(不仅仅是海港城镇)在此日期前缴纳船舶税.
te: Writs issued in February by Charles I of England mandate that every county in England (not just seaport towns) pay ship…
dz: 英国查理一世于2月所发的文字授权英格兰的每个郡(不仅仅是海港城镇)在此日期前缴纳船舶税.
de: Writs issued in February by Charles I of England mandate that every county in England (not just seaport towns) pay ship tax by this date.

t: 63名胡格诺特人在法国瓦西被屠杀,标志着法国宗教战争的开始.
te: Sixty-three Huguenots are massacred in Wassy, France, marking the start of the French Wars of Religion.
dz: 63名胡格诺特人在法国瓦西被屠杀,标志着法国宗教战争的开始.
de: Sixty-three Huguenots are massacred in Wassy, France, marking the start of the French Wars of Religion.

de: Forces of the Catholic Monarchs engage the combined Portuguese-Castilian armies of Afonso V and Prince John at the Battle of Toro.

te: University of Coimbra, in Portugal, is officially chartered by King Denis.
dz: 葡萄牙科英布拉大学由德尼国王正式包租.
de: University of Coimbra, in Portugal, is officially chartered by King Denis.

dz: 皇帝路易虔诚被恢复为法兰克人帝国的唯一统治者.
de: Emperor Louis the Pious is restored as sole ruler of the Frankish Empire.

t: 韦特拉尼奥在被君士坦提乌斯二世的妹妹君士坦提纳所鼓励后自称为凯撒.
te: Vetranio proclaims himself Caesar after being encouraged to do so by Constantina, sister of Constantius II.
dz: 韦特拉尼奥在被君士坦提乌斯二世的妹妹君士坦提纳所鼓励后自称为凯撒.
de: Vetranio proclaims himself Caesar after being encouraged to do so by Constantina, sister of Constantius II.

t: 戴克里先皇帝和马克西米安皇帝任命康斯坦提乌斯·克洛鲁斯和加莱里乌斯为凯撒。这被认为是四帝制的开…
te: Emperor Diocletian and Maximian appoint Constantius Chlorus and Galerius as Caesars. This is considered the beginning o…
dz: 戴克里先皇帝和马克西米安皇帝任命康斯坦提乌斯·克洛鲁斯和加莱里乌斯为凯撒。这被认为是四帝制的开始，被称为 Quattuor Principes Mundi（“世界四位统治者”）。
de: Emperor Diocletian and Maximian appoint Constantius Chlorus and Galerius as Caesars. This is considered the beginning of the Tetrarchy, known as the Quattuor Principes Mundi ("Four Rulers of the World").

t: 普布利乌斯·瓦列里乌斯·普罗莫拉(Publius Valerius Publius)在席尔瓦·…
te: Publius Valerius Publicola celebrates the first triumph of the Roman Republic after his victory over the deposed king L…
dz: 普布利乌斯·瓦列里乌斯·普罗莫拉(Publius Valerius Publius)在席尔瓦·阿西亚战役中战胜被废黜的国王卢修斯·塔奎尼乌斯(Lucius Tarquinius Superbus)后,庆祝了罗马共和国的首次胜利.
de: Publius Valerius Publicola celebrates the first triumph of the Roman Republic after his victory over the deposed king Lucius Tarquinius Superbus at the Battle of Silva Arsia.
